channel.title: The Grant Desk - Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
  • IKSV Young Artist Fund: International Circulation Support Programme (Turkey)
    https://www.iksv.org/tr/genc-sanatci-fonu-uluslararasi-dolasim-destek-programi/acik-cagri
    Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (IKSV) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 1,300 per recipient towards documented travel costs (economy flights, trains, buses and public transport; accommodation in some cases). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.

    https://inlaksfoundation.submittable.com/submit/75e14093-df9b-41c5-af96-ce2360e64e1b/the-inlaks-fine-art-award-2027

  • Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation: Inlaks Theatre Art Award 2027
    https://www.inlaksfoundation.org/
    Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · INR 15,000 per month for up to 12 months, around INR 180,000 total (roughly USD 2,050 / EUR 1,780). No application fee.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Earth Journalism Network: Story Grants for Inclusive Water Governance in the Mekong Region 2026
    https://earthjournalism.net/opportunities/story-grants-to-support-reporting-on-inclusive-water-governance-in-the-mekong-region
    Earth Journalism Network (Internews), with support from Oxfam · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · Up to USD 2,000 per story grant; up to 13 grants awarded. Grants issued July 2026. Selected journalists also receive one-on-one mentorship, including from a Gender Equity and Social Inclusion (GESI) specialist. No application fee.
  • AIR Taipei: International Artist Residency 2027 (Taipei Artist Village & Treasure Hill)
    https://air-artistvillage.org.tw/
    Taipei Culture Foundation (AIR Taipei, operating Taipei Artist Village and Treasure Hill Artist Village) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Funding varies by track. INTERNATIONAL RESIDENCY (open to international artists): free accommodation and studio space plus administrative and project support; no cash artist grant. PUPPETRY RESIDENCY (Treasure Hill x Puppetry Art Center, open to international artists): NT$20,000 (around USD 620) subsidy plus accommodation and studio. OVERSEAS RESIDENCY VISIT (Taiwanese artists only): NT$100,000 (around USD 3,100) creative grant plus economy-class roundtrip airfare. No application fee.
  • APWLD: Breaking Out of Marginalisation (BOOM) Feminist Participatory Action Research, Feminist Food Sovereignty 2026-2028
    https://apwld.org/call-for-applications-breaking-out-of-marginalisation-boom-feminist-participatory-action-research-fpar-2026-2028/
    Asia Pacific Forum on Women, Law and Development (APWLD) · deadline Closed 05 Jul 2026 · Sub-grant of up to USD 14,000 per selected partner organisation to support the employment of a young woman researcher and cover direct research, implementation, advocacy and capacity-building costs (not institutional sustainability or maintenance). Also includes capacity-building workshops, regional training, advocacy and networking opportunities, and ongoing accompaniment. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

  • TOKAS Research Residency Program 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-321.html

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Diriyah Art Futures: Emerging New Media Artists Program 2026/27 (Riyadh)
    https://engage.moc.gov.sa/reg_forms/tracks/250/?lang=en
    Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), in collaboration with Le Fresnoy - Studio National des Arts Contemporains · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · Production budget; access to advanced audio-visual labs, immersive-reality and spatial audio-visual environments; cutting-edge professional equipment; multidisciplinary mentorship from international digital and new-media artists; and a culminating curated group exhibition at DAF in October 2027. Specific stipend amount not stated in the public call. No application fee.
  • CBPS Research Fellowship 2026-27 (Bengaluru)
    https://cbps.in/
    Centre for Budget and Policy Studies (CBPS) · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · INR 25,000 per month stipend, plus access to office space, internet and the CBPS library. The fellowship does NOT cover housing, transportation or any other financial support. No application fee.
  • Berggruen Institute: Peking University Research Center Fellowship 2026-2027 (Beijing)
    https://berggruen.org/news/call-for-application-bic-fellowship-26-27
    Berggruen Institute China Center, Peking University · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · 200,000 CNY annual stipend, paid monthly before tax. Fellows are responsible for their own income tax. No application fee.
  • Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS): International Creator Residency 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-317.html
    Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS), Tokyo Metropolitan Foundation for History and Culture · deadline Closed 16 Jun 2026 · Round-trip economy-class airfare between nearest airport and Tokyo (Narita or Haneda); per diem living expenses of JPY 4,200 per day (excl. tax); fee for work/project of JPY 300,000 (excl. tax); living space (single room) and access to shared studio. Note: 20.42% income tax is deducted from per-diem and project-fee amounts. For duos, airfare is provided for both members but per diem and project fee are paid for one person only. No application fee.
